entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [.Net 10] [Windows] Build failure when using Identity.Client.Desktop.WinUI3 nuget #32683
  • [.NET 10] Xaml Source Gen - Obsolete methods used in source generator #32681
  • [.NET 10] Xaml Source Gen - Argument 1: cannot convert from 'double' to 'float' - FlexLayout.Basis #32680
  • [.NET 10] Xaml Source Gen - A static anonymous function cannot contain a reference to 'extension' #32679
  • Update official supported version page after .NET 10 GA #32675
  • [Android] FlowDirection not working on EmptyView in CollectionView #32673
  • Row/Col definition aren't FQ #32670
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Navbar keeps reserving space after navigating to page with `Shell.NavBarIsVisible="False"` #32667
  • 'AppThemeBinding' is inaccessible due to its protection level with XamlSourceGenerator on Version 10.0.20-ci.main.25566.1 #32665
  • TabbedPage crashes on iPadOS 26.1 with windowed applications in narrow viewports #32661
    .NET 10.0 SR2

Closed

  • InvalidProgramException when binding to a static property #12101
    Backlog
  • Support x:Name for code generation in DataTemplate #13760
    Backlog
  • Make IProvideParentValues public #8825
    Backlog
  • Better XAML Compilation for Styles #5574
    Backlog
  • Delete the OnDestroy override from ShellFragmentContainer #31716
    .NET 11 Planning
  • DatePickers in CollectionView2 sometimes display wrong value #32322
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • Randomly release build fails or succeeded without any code change #32657
  • [Windows] MAUI Label LineHeight is not same in .NET 9 and .NET 10 #32434

PullRequests

Created

  • Make AppThemeBinding class public #32678
    area-xaml, xsg
  • Add implicit string to GridLength cast operator #32676
    area-xaml
  • Fixed FlowDirection not working on EmptyView in CollectionView [iOS, macOS] #32674
    partner/syncfusion
  • [iOS] Fixed Current Item change on Device Orientation #32672
    platform/ios, area-controls-collectionview, community ✨, collectionview-cv2, partner/syncfusion
  • Fix #32670: Generate fully qualified Row/ColumnDefinition types in SourceGen #32671
    area-xaml, xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Android, iOS, Mac] Fix inconsistent Background vs BackgroundColor behavior in CollectionView selection with VSM #32669
    partner/syncfusion
  • [iOS][CV2] Fix Rotating the Simulator causes the text on the collection view to disappear. #32664
    partner/syncfusion
  • IndexOutOfRangeException nullable enums #32663
    area-xaml, p/0, xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Fix TabbedPage crash on iPadOS 26+ with narrow viewports #32662
  • Fix crash when TimePicker.Time is set to null #32660
    community ✨

Merged

  • [release/10.0.1xx-sr1] predictive back gesture support for Android 13+ #32635
  • [ci] Add variable group MAUI #32610

Updated

  • Replace deprecated ScreenResolutionUtility task with PowerShell script for Windows UI tests #32599
  • Experimental interface IBehavior #32350
    area-xaml, community ✨
  • prevent tabs from being removed during Disappearing #30290
    area-navigation, area-controls-tabbedpage, community ✨
  • Fix Shell content page title clipping on Android API 28-29 with window insets compatibility #32537
    partner/syncfusion/review, .NET 10.0 SR1.1
  • [Windows]Fix for Custom TitleBar Errors During App Closure with Modal Navigation #32589
    partner/syncfusion
  • Fix for Page OnAppearing triggered twice when navigating via ShellItem change with PresentationMode set to Modal #32582
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [Windows]Fix TabbedPage pages provided by a DataTemplate crash when swapping to a different tab #32577
    platform/windows, area-controls-tabbedpage, partner/syncfusion
  • [Android] Fix ScrollView scroll position changes unexpectedly when Orientation is set to Horizontal and FlowDirection is RTL at runtime #32531
    partner/syncfusion
  • [iOS] Fix ScrollView with RTL FlowDirection and Horizontal Orientation scrolls in the wrong direction #32529
    partner/syncfusion
  • Add warning for duplicate property assignments in XAML #32654
    area-xaml
  • Fix TabBar not visible on Mac Catalyst #32528

  • [Android] Fix for App Hang When PopModalAsync Is Called Immediately After PushModalAsync with Task.Yield() #32479

  • [iOS] Fix for Shell Navigation Bar Remaining Visible After Navigating Back to a ContentPage with NavigationBar Hidden #32622
